title: Okay Quality
text:
Okay Quality. The box is a reasonable size; 6" x 4" x 2.75". The opening, a slider panel in the bottom which I had a very hard time opening. Granted you may only open this once or twice in your lifetime it still requires some effort to open a thin, fragile, door.
The carving is delicate and attractive and the wood is nice but the carving poorly done in places with cuts that extend into places they shouldn't. It's just a lack of attention to detail. It depends on how you feel about your loved one. This box is pretty but imperfect. That might matter to you.
